videos.video_subject: Mohamed Salah's family home in the Egyptian village of Nagrig was burgled and his father caught one of the thieves, but Salah asked his father to drop the charges and gave the man money to start a new life
videos.video_script: Thieves robbed Mohamed Salah's home. His father caught one. Salah refused to press charges, and gave the man money instead.
